newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB sees at least steady 1997 net.
newsitem.headline: ABB sees at least steady 1997 net.

text.p: Electrical engineering group ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG said it expected group net profit in 1997 to at least reach the same level as in 1996, confirming the company's forecast last issued on April 3.
ABB also said the second year of economic slowdown in Western Europe continued to affect demand for many of its industrial and investment goods, as it had expected.
Good growth in emerging markets and the favourable effects of cost reduction programmes again benefited the group's results positively, ABB said in its quarterly statement.
On a comparable basis, ABB's 1996 group net profit rose 16 percent to 1,233 million.
